questions.prompt: What does graded practice mean here?
questions.answer: Varying ordinary task demands in voluntary learning exercises.
No; task complexity and feedback can be varied without inducing distress.
To assess transfer beyond memorising one response.

questions.prompt: Can a learner decline oral role-play?
questions.answer: Yes; equivalent accessible formats may demonstrate the same objective.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only; use answer-specific feedback.
scoring.practice: Designs voluntary, accessible, low-risk task practice with feedback, transfer and clear non-clinical boundaries.
scoring.transfer: Create a three-variant low-stakes practice plan for a fictional social skill. Include criteria, an accessible format, a stop option and a comparable new case. Explain how it differs from clinical exposure.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; no averaging away omissions or safety-critical criteria. No automatic competency award.
